title: Past Tense
intro: The Russian past tense is remarkably simple compared to present tense. Instead of six different endings for each person, there are only FOUR forms total - based on gender and number. Remove the -ть from the infinitive and add: -л (masculine), -ла (feminine), -ло (neuter), -ли (plural/formal). The subject determines which ending to use.
rules: Past tense agrees with GENDER and NUMBER, not person: я читал (m), я читала (f), мы читали (pl).
я takes masculine or feminine based on speaker's gender: я читал (male), я читала (female).
вы always uses -ли, whether formal singular or plural.
Some verbs have irregular past tense stems. Common examples: мочь → мог/могла (drop -чь, add -г), идти → шёл/шла (completely different stem).
examples: Я читал книгу. (I read a book., male speaker)
Я читала книгу. (I read a book., female speaker)
Мы смотрели фильм. (We watched a movie.)

items.prompt: Он _____ книгу вчера. (He read a book yesterday.)
items.explanation: Он (he) is masculine singular, so use -л ending: читал.

items.prompt: Она _____ в магазине. (She worked at the store.)
items.explanation: Она (she) is feminine singular, so use -ла ending: работала.
Мы (we) is plural, so use -ли ending: смотрели.

items.prompt: Вчера я _____ дома. (Yesterday I was at home. - female speaker)
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday I was at home. (female speaker)
items.explanation: When a woman says 'I was,' use была (feminine).

items.prompt: Они _____ в Москве. (They were in Moscow.)
items.explanation: Они (they) is plural, so use были.

items.prompt: Анна _____ по телефону. (Anna talked on the phone.)
items.explanation: Анна is a woman's name (feminine), so use говорила.

items.prompt: Дети _____ в парке. (The children played in the park.)
items.promptEnglish: The children played in the park.
items.explanation: Дети (children) is plural, so use играли.
Иван is a man's name (masculine), so use писал.

blanks: Она _____ утром. (She worked in the morning.)
Мы _____ весь день. (We worked all day.)
Радио _____ весь вечер. (The radio worked all evening.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Past tense agrees with gender/number of subject
hints: Он is masculine singular — which past tense ending matches?
Она is feminine singular — which past tense ending matches?
Мы is plural — which past tense ending matches?
Радио is neuter — which past tense ending matches?
explanations: Он (he) is masculine singular, so use the -л ending: работал.
Она (she) is feminine singular, so use the -ла ending: работала.
Мы (we) is plural, so use the -ли ending: работали.
Радио (radio) is neuter, so use the -ло ending: работало.
